title: Visual oddball target detection from EEG
disposition_reason: The current source implements target-stimulus probability for the complete exposed 400-trial/two-person development panel, including numerical no-tools contexts and a typed image viewer. This is a scoped human ERP decoding assay; physical display timing, independent amplitude calibration, participant isolation and model/human performance remain unqualified.

scientific_target.question: Can an observer infer whether a released-marker-locked human EEG epoch followed a target versus standard stimulus, and how do representation, demonstration budget and processing access affect this fixed development-panel result?
scientific_target.known_answer: The binary target/standard identity bound to each of the 400 public opaque trial IDs; answer is an experimental event label, not presence of an idealized P3 shape.
scientific_target.answer_origin: Pinned private target arrays joined to authentic ERP CORE active-visual-oddball trials; the four demonstrations carry public training labels.
scientific_target.case_unit: One 1,024-sample Cz/Pz epoch; 200 trials within each of development-001 and development-002.
scientific_target.independent_unit: Human participant; two previously exposed development people, with repeated trials nested within person.
scientific_target.inference_scope: Retrospective target-stimulus decoding from a processed epoch. The original question about neural information beyond timing/repetition needs nuisance comparisons; classification alone cannot attribute a P3 mechanism or exclude ocular/motor responses.
exclusions: No mouse seizure data or MouseEEG replication.
No unseen-population or prospective pre-response claim.
No direct/native model understanding conclusion from the historical feature-programme score.

inputs: Numerical direct and matched numerical-programme conditions: all 1,024 samples in Cz and Pz at 1,024 Hz, native offsets -256..767, rereferenced to (P9+P10)/2 and baseline-subtracted on offsets -256..-1; amplitude remains native EEGLAB units.

Exactly four balanced labeled training demonstrations for the numerical direct condition and the four_demo viewer condition; zero_shot viewer receives none. Their balance is not the source class prior.

The ordinary feature programme separately receives six training people/1,200 labeled trials and fixed EEG, ocular, gross-amplitude and history features; it is not information-matched to four demonstrations.
forbidden_inputs: Query target/response event codes, private target arrays, training feature banks outside the declared condition, source identifiers beyond current opaque trial ID, other evaluation queries, evaluator feedback.
Raw arrays, arbitrary code, files, shell and retrieval in the typed viewer; tools/files/retrieval in direct-observation transport.
observation_contract.case_identity: The existing public validator requires exactly development-001 and development-002 with 200 unique IDs each; the complete roster commitment is 82405f12a9e8f302a27a5641241378a4f2000bef2849fece555b8843ca92d2d4. Raw source identities remain operator-side.
observation_contract.split: Existing six-person feature-training/two-person exposed-development separation is preserved. Every direct/viewer episode is a fresh single-query condition; no new held-out cohort or label exposure reset is claimed.
observation_contract.coverage: All 400 query waveforms and four training demonstrations were independently recomputed from pinned raw epochs; viewer evidence authenticates the full roster but renders only selected authentic queries plus demonstrations. A complete generated 400-session collection is software evidence, not 400 model episodes.

primary.name: participant_macro_balanced_accuracy at target_probability >= 0.5
primary.aggregation: Mean target/non-target recall within person, then equal mean across the two complete people; undefined if required class support is absent.
primary.rationale: Preserves the current operational target and prevents the majority standard class from dominating accuracy; no scientific pass threshold is defined.

secondary: Equal-person natural-log loss with metric-only clipping at 1e-15; retain raw submitted probabilities.
Per-person class support/confusion and signed candidate-minus-reference differences for all six fixed references.

Future condition comparisons must report identical-query paired differences separately for zero-shot, four-demo, numerical direct, numerical tool-assisted and richer feature-programme arms; do not pool their label budgets.

comparators.name: Frozen six-arm feature references
comparators.inputs: Existing 1,200 labeled feature-training trials; prior, EEG, EOG-site, gross amplitude, behavioral history and EEG+history arms.
comparators.procedure: Use the existing frozen reference grade/commit and exact reference source lineage; no refit on development labels. These are implemented feature-route controls, not matched four-demo controls.

comparators.name: Matched numerical waveform programme
comparators.inputs: Exactly the direct numerical prompt, four demonstrations and one query.
comparators.procedure: Freeze per-query procedure and use a fresh isolated process; this source-delivered condition has no model/programme comparison result and needs executed isolation.

comparators.name: Prospective matched visual and human observations
comparators.inputs: The identical zero-shot or four-demo viewer action/image interface, separately labeled conditions.
comparators.procedure: Freeze participant/model protocol and navigation budget before a future study; human performance is unmeasured and no benchmark value is imputed.

nuisance_controls: Retain ocular-site, gross-amplitude, history and EEG+history references; the packet includes post-marker activity that can include motor/ocular signals.
Bind the actual event-transform history before applying a physical 26-ms display correction; current frozen epochs add no new shift.
Record raster gain/clipping/window/action history; equal source epochs do not guarantee equal visual/numeric information.
Keep zero-shot, four-demo and sequential-feedback designs separate; feedback is not implemented.
evaluation.uncertainty: Report two descriptive person scores and paired condition differences. Trials are nested and the two exposed people do not support a population confidence interval or reliable human-versus-model population claim.
evaluation.failure_policy: Require all 400 request-bound scalar responses/IDs before private scoring. Preserve failures and first finalized response; reject duplicates, swaps, NaN, booleans, prose, extras, missing cases and mixed modes without selective omission.

implementation.scorer_target: Genuine event-label decoding from EEG-derived observations, equal-person balanced accuracy and log loss; it does not compare copied source tables or require author predictions.
implementation.delivered_scope: Numerical source, strict submission validator, portable external-artifact grader, complete matched waveform contexts and a typed visual viewer cover the existing 400 development queries. The full original source inventory and untouched population objective are not delivered.
missing: Qualified model transport enforcing actual image/no-tools-only access and fresh state per query.
Executed matched waveform/visual model comparisons and any human comparison.
Independent physical display-clock/amplitude qualification and a prospectively protected population evaluation.
implementation.execution_evidence: Pinned published evidence records authentic 400-query/four-demo materialization and selected authentic rendering plus generated software controls. It explicitly records zero model calls/trials; this revision reads source only.

direct_observation.representation: Complete numerical Cz/Pz waveforms and four labeled examples, one query per fresh no-tools context.
direct_observation.boundary: Only the exact prompt and scalar response; no tools/retrieval/files or cross-query memory.
missing: Qualified no-tools transport and full-context model capacity; no direct model result.

typed_viewer.representation: PNG traces with typed inspect/select/window/scroll/zoom/gain/channels/finalize; zero_shot and four_demo are separate conditions.
typed_viewer.boundary: No raw-array return or code; at most128 actions including initial overview/finalization; fresh query state and all 400 terminal attempts required.
missing: Actual restricted participant transport and image delivery qualification; no viewer model trial.

tool_assisted.representation: The matched_waveform_programme source constructs the same four demonstrations and one-query prompt for a predeclared numerical programme. It does not implement an adaptive model investigator or a participant numerical-tool controller.
tool_assisted.boundary: A future adaptive episode must receive only this one-query information and accounted tools/compute, with fresh state and no evaluator feedback or richer feature bank.
missing: An actual adaptive participant/controller/tool boundary, distinct from frozen-programme context export.
Executed per-case model/tool comparison and independently verified query isolation.

frozen_program.representation: Precommitted feature programme with six-person training bank, or separately predeclared matched waveform method.
frozen_program.boundary: Freeze code/fitting/adaptation recipe before queries; richer feature and waveform conditions must be reported separately.
missing: Prospective protected evaluation and independently verified complete execution for a new candidate.
